description: Bounded size-structured growth/removal counterexample: exact equal population power-law MLE, unequal independently specified mass profiles. Frozen locally before simulation; not an external preregistration.

resource.name: mass
resource.definition: Per-object stock q(x)=x in declared mass units, independently fixed across all removal conditions.

observation_design: Independent uniformly sampled extant objects conditional on cohort size, all within the fixed domain. Continuous log sizes generate both the exact bounded power-law MLE and the binned count profile. No conserved sampled-resource total is imposed.
decisions: Exponent-only: absolute deviation of bounded continuous power-law MLE from the frozen neutral exponent. Full profile: multinomial deviance from the frozen neutral bin probabilities. Independent null calibration uses Monte Carlo rank p values, reject at alpha. Non-rejection is compatibility, never resource equivalence.
streams: PCG64 SeedSequence([seed, stage, sample_size_index, scenario_index]); stage 10 calibration, 20 held-out validation. Scenarios ordered neutral, curved_same_exponent, shifted_power.
interpretation: Known transport/removal dynamics and deliberate moment matching construct an identification limit. Results test the sufficiency of an exponent and quantify observation requirements; they do not establish autonomous resource neutrality, a natural law, or novelty of standard moment identities.
